description.value: Hedley Country Market is a convenience/country market serving the small historic mining town of Hedley in BC's Similkameen Valley. Situated along the Crowsnest Highway (Hwy 3), it is one of the few provisioning stops in this stretch of rugged, sparsely populated terrain between Princeton and Keremeos. For touring cyclists riding this corridor, it represents a meaningful resupply opportunity in an otherwise remote section.
